confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Food and drink anchors are more reliable than hotel anchors, which vary widely by location and seasonal demand. Cocktail and wine anchors are set at about 5 to 5.5 times the draft beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Vietnamese coastal tourist cities such as Da Nang and Hoi An for accommodation and bar prices, and against Ho Chi Minh City for everyday food and cafe prices.
